title: fix(agent): keep external memory provider when built-in memory import fails
claim: A failing `from tools.memory_tool import ...` in _init_memory must not leave mem_config unbound and thereby drop the configured external memory provider (UnboundLocalError swallowed as 'Memory provider plugin init failed').

evidence.red: Defect still present on f848940 (agent/agent_init.py:1336 binds mem_config only inside `with suppress(Exception)`; l.1359 reads it in the provider block). Ran upstream #126106's tests/agent/test_memory_bootstrap_independence.py (head 1d5d0a25) against f848940: 7 failed, 3 passed, e.g. `AssertionError: built-in import disabled the external provider / assert None is not None (_memory_manager)`. Fork's own test (tests/run_agent/test_mem_config_unbound_init.py) is stale on main: 3 errors `run_agent has no attribute get_tool_definitions` (fixture drift), not a valid RED.
evidence.green: Applied #126106's one-line fix (`_cfg_dict(_agent_cfg, "memory").get("provider", "")`) on f848940: test_memory_bootstrap_independence + test_memory_provider_init + test_memory_provider_unavailable_warning -> 3 files, 19 passed, 0 failed (local only, discarded).
evidence.negative_control: n/a (not rebuilt: externally owned); main itself is the negative control above
evidence.adjacent: tests/agent/test_memory_provider_init.py, tests/agent/test_memory_provider_unavailable_warning.py pass with #126106's fix (included in the 19)
evidence.source: Real trigger is narrow: get_builtin_memory_config never raises, so only an ImportError of tools.memory_tool (broken install) reaches the unbound path.

upstream_overlap: #126106 OPEN Wenfengcheng 'fix(memory): decouple external provider selection from built-in import' (MERGEABLE, head 1d5d0a2562d5) - same root cause, same fix shape via existing _cfg_dict, stronger test (public AIAgent ctor, disk-installed provider fixture)
#125919 OPEN issue (yuichro) - parent issue; #126106 is 'Part of'
notes: Support, don't compete. Our version adds only one thing #126106 lacks: a once-per-process WARNING ('Built-in memory store unavailable: %s') replacing the silent suppress(Exception) around the built-in store. That is a separate diagnostic contract, arguably scope creep for #126106 and adjacent to #125960's diagnostics lane; at most offer it as a review suggestion. Our test adds nothing beyond #126106's (and is stale on main). Possible review receipt: #126106's fix + tests are GREEN on current main f848940 (19 passed) and its tests are RED on main without the fix.
